status: PASS: equations/numerics within tested regimes; physical calcium-gap limitation documented separately

independence_scope.RHS: Independent Python equations versus both network_core.lib and header model.cuh; 200 states and 34 boundary conditions.
independence_scope.DOP853: Isolated first-four-variable astrocyte module with prescribed zero or constant glutamate, not an independent full neuron-synapse-astrocyte trajectory.
independence_scope.resources: Analytic xA/GA and independent scalar GammaS ODE conditional on exported release events; separate exact continuous calcium event-time check.
independence_scope.full_system: Step refinement of the complete 2-pre/1-post/1-astrocyte system on 5 seconds; binary-equivalence check against the existing production CLI; not an independent full-system ODE reference.

limitations.severity: P2 scientific interpretation when calcium gap is used as physical intercellular transport
limitations.finding: Cytosolic concentrations exchange conservatively, but each inferred local total remains constant. With all ER fluxes off, an inferred ER concentration changes to compensate calcium-gap flux.
limitations.reproduction: harness probe / gap scenarios: dC=(+.08,-.08) uM/s but inferred dCER=(-.432432,+.432432) uM/s while dCT=0.
limitations.recommendation: Call this phenomenological calcium coupling, or add per-cell total calcium / explicit ER state if physical mass transport is intended.
limitations.boundary: Default calcium gap is zero; ordinary IP3-only coupling and isolated astrocyte equations are unaffected.

limitations.finding: SIC is an instantaneous saturating glutamate-dependent conductance without explicit NMDAR kinetics or magnesium block; README already discloses this reduction.

Wide globally accepted rate ranges are not an RK4 stability guarantee; the root audit independently tests that problem. This component audit validates the stated default/controlled parameter regimes only.
